page.overview:
Who is Howden Ganley?

James Howden Ganley (born 24 December 1941 in Hamilton, Waikato Region, North Island, New Zealand) is a retired racing driver from New Zealand who drove in Formula One from to .

After a strong season in European Formula 5000, Ganley was signed up to drive for for 1971, making his début at the . Leaving BRM at the end of the season, Ganley moved to Frank Williams' team for , nearly being credited with victory at the because of a timing mix-up. In , Ganley drove the first two races for before leaving, helping the Japanese effort, for whom failed to qualify twice mid-season. He never raced in F1 again.
